longBusinessSummary: Roze AI Inc., through its subsidiary, develops AI-enabled fire and disaster-prevention technologies integrating wireless sensing, digital-twin software, and data analytics. The company offers the Disaster AI Platform (DAP), a digital twin AI wireless fire system for fire and disaster monitoring, forecasting, early warning and response, and fire prevention, comprising the Rozeta IoT Platform, the Rozeta Data Platform, and the Rozeta Service Platform. The company's Rozeta IoT Platform includes fire detectors, complex IoT sensors covering smoke, temperature, humidity, carbon monoxide, flame, vibration, current, and pressure, along with repeaters, alert devices, and control panels. Its Rozeta Data Platform handles data collection, storage, and processing, while the Rozeta Service Platform provides digital twins, dashboards, and a Metaverse environment. It also designs, manufactures, and sells wireless fire detecting and alarming devices and systems. The company offers Fire4Cast, an AI fire forecasting system that applies anomaly detection, calculates a Fire Risk Index for each building, and integrates Fire Dynamics Simulator data with real-world sensor inputs. It provides RozetaTwin digital-twin software for facility modeling, simulation, evacuation planning, and maintenance workflows, along with the DAP Cloud Service that connects sensor data, AI analysis, and real-time visualization through dashboards, 3D simulation, and Metaverse-based training. Additionally, the company offers So.S Home acoustic sensing for sound-field-based safety applications and RozeVerse and RozeVR immersive fire-response training environments. It also designs and constructs firefighting systems. The company serves corporate customers across commercial buildings, manufacturing plants, power plants, and residential complexes, along with government agencies, the military, public institutions, and individual consumers. Roze AI Inc. was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
